cases.summary: Table editor filter input loses focus after debounce
cases.description:
See if we can avoid losing focus after debouncing - because we're now updating the URL state with the filter and sorts
otherwise consider only enacting the filter on blur

evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix: Table editor filter input loses focus after debounce

## What kind of change does this PR introduce?

Bug fix

## What is the current behavior?

When typing in a filter value, input field loses focus after debouncing

Closes https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues/7658

## What is the new behavior?

- When typing in a filter value, input field maintains focus even after debouncing


https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26940294/193802248-3cdc2b73-b68f-4438-be33-3219ff701efb.mov
